bus_drain.basis: The stock firmware drains the bus with a discarded read of the end of its first memory region: helper 0x17f1794 (slot 1) and classifier 0x17f15b0 read 0x80000000, where X-T5 and X-S20 read 0x60000000 and X100VI 0x68000000.

xh2s.dram_basis: The stock bus-drain helpers split memory at 0x80000000; the first region ends there. Memory above it (0x80000000..0x98000000) is used by a debug-gated memory test at 0x306b1d4, so installed capacity is larger and unmeasured.
